convert_pose_encoding_to_camera: convert a pose encoding tensor to a pytorch3d PerspectiveCameras object with focal length, rotation, and translation
convert_camera_to_pose_encoding: convert a pytorch3d camera object to a pose encoding tensor with translation, quaternion rotation, and log focal length
adjust_camera_to_bbox_crop: adjust camera focal length and principal point when cropping an image to a bounding box region
adjust_camera_to_image_scale: adjust camera focal length and principal point when resizing an image to a new width and height
convert_bbox_xyxy_to_xywh: convert a bounding box from xyxy format to xywh format using numpy array operations
